Source statement: Residents and registered local groups may request the community room at no charge.
Summary wording: The community room is free for residents and local groups.
What was lost: Registration requirement; permission to request does not ensure use.
Why it matters: An unregistered group could plan an event despite not qualifying.

Source statement: A booking is confirmed only after staff send a confirmation email.
What was lost: Staff confirmation email; request is not a confirmed booking.
Why it matters: An organizer could rely on an unconfirmed slot.

Source statement: Room access is available from 09:00 to 18:00, Tuesday through Saturday.
Summary wording: It is available Tuesday to Saturday.
Why it matters: Someone could plan Saturday evening use outside the window.

Source statement: An adult organizer must supervise any event involving participants under 18.
What was lost: Adult organizer must supervise events involving under-18 participants.
Why it matters: A youth group could lack required supervision.

Source statement: Wheelchair access is through the east entrance. Request the portable hearing loop at least 48 hours before the event.
What was lost: East entrance; request portable hearing loop at least 48 hours ahead.
Why it matters: A wheelchair user could reach the wrong entrance; hearing support may not be arranged.

Source statement: Food is allowed, except hot cooking. Allergy-sensitive events may require additional restrictions.
What was lost: Hot cooking exception; possible additional allergy restrictions.
Why it matters: Catering plans could include prohibited hot cooking or unsuitable food.

Source statement: Same-day requests may be accepted, subject to staff availability.
What was lost: Conditional request acceptance; staff availability; no guarantee.
Why it matters: An organizer could expect automatic acceptance.
